subject: Lane A — Gemini VLM delivery and verification
description:
Lane A — Gemini VLM delivery and verification

Implement and verify the Gemini VLM integration only in this strange_ai repository on the current VLM feature branch.

Grounded context: scripts/process_vlm.py currently extracts and validates exactly eight JPEG keyframes before building VlmFramePayload. ai/vlm_sdk.py::GeminiVlmProvider is a placeholder. The teammate owns keyframe extraction and de-identification internals; do not modify those internals and do not add pass-through/fake de-identification. If the teammate de-identification API is absent, preserve a clean explicit integration boundary and report that concrete blocker rather than sending raw frames.

Delivery scope:
- Implement real multimodal Gemini request logic in ai/vlm_sdk.py: eight JPEGs, sanitized incident metadata and a Korean safety-analysis prompt, structured JSON response, configurable model, timeout, bounded retry for transient failures, parsing, and schema validation.
- Wire scripts/process_vlm.py so only successfully de-identified frames can reach Gemini. A de-identification exception must produce zero provider calls. Preserve mock mode.
- Update production result validation if it is currently mock-only, without weakening mock assertions.
- Never log API keys or image bytes; never fall back to raw frame transmission.
- Do not touch clip_worker.py, MP4 blur, other repositories, root contracts, or teammate-owned keyframe/de-identification implementation.

Verification scope:
- Add focused request/response tests with mocked network transport.
- Cover exactly-eight enforcement, malformed responses, timeout/transient retry behavior, no call on de-identification failure, mock compatibility, and no secret/image-byte leakage.
- Run the focused VLM test suite and report exact commands and results.

Likely files: ai/vlm_sdk.py, scripts/process_vlm.py, ai/vlm/contracts.py only if needed, and VLM tests under tests/.

Runtime limitation: the required context snapshot could not be persisted through direct agent mutation because .gjc is runtime-owned; this task text is the grounded intake snapshot. Inspect current files before editing and do not guess the teammate API.
